svg.title: Stereo-PIV: Focus both cameras on the board
svg.desc: Place the calibration board (generate it in PIVlab) where you will measure. Adjust focus and Scheimpflug angle until the whole board is sharp in both cameras. Tip: the Sharpness overlay of the PIVlab live image rates the left, centre and right third. Drawing: PIVlab, www.pivlab.de, CC BY 4.0.
svg.text: Focus both cameras on the board
Place the calibration board (generate it in PIVlab) where you will measure.
Adjust focus and Scheimpflug angle until the whole board is sharp in both cameras.
Tip: the Sharpness overlay of the PIVlab live image rates the left, centre and right third.
